dropRules.description: Eligible level-80+ monsters can drop this avatarite. Fire weather selects this element; without elemental weather, the matching Vana’diel day selects it. Weather takes priority over day. The monster must not check Too Weak to the highest-level participant. Battlefield monsters, Dynamis and monsters with no-loot/no-experience restrictions do not qualify.
dropRules.rateNote: A separate 20% roll only after the geode roll fails (16% overall when eligible).
